title: Add the Missing Link
prompt:
The page below has a paragraph but no way to move on. Add an anchor element that links to `https://example.com` with the visible text `Learn more`.

Rules:
- The link target goes in the `href` attribute.
- The visible text `Learn more` sits between the opening and closing anchor tags.

tests.name: contains an anchor element
tests.hint: Links are created with the <a> (anchor) element and an href attribute.

tests.name: links to https://example.com
tests.hint: Set the href attribute exactly to https://example.com (in quotes).

tests.name: visible text is 'Learn more'
tests.hint: Put the text 'Learn more' between and .
